title: The input order of string aggregations needs to be specified explicitly
summary: When SQLite does not specify internal ordering of aggregates, the input order of group_concat is not guaranteed.
applies: SQLite query results and crossing dialect boundaries
detail: In versions that support ORDER BY within aggregates, specifying a sort on the aggregate inputs determines the splicing order. The outer ORDER BY primarily sorts the result rows.
boundary: ORDER BY within aggregate parameters is available since SQLite 3.44.0, older versions do not assume acceptance of this syntax.
relevance: Distinguish data changes and unspecified order when reconstructing the same string of spliced text multiple times.
